remarksWeb: Notes: 1. In accordance with SEBI Circular dated November 30, 2015 read alongwith SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018, Tata AIA Life Insurance Company Limited and Tata AIG General Insurance Companies holding of 27,89,279 Equity shares and 42,52,659 Equity Shares respectively, of Rs. 2 each in the Company, are not considered part of Promoter Group of the shareholding pattern. They are part of Public Shareholding under the head Institutions- Insurance Companies. Additionally as per the SEBI circular dated June 30, 2022 bearing no. SEBI/HO/CFD/PoD-1/P/CIR/2022/92 have been sub categorised as Shareholders acting as persons in concert with promoters.   2. Tata Sons Private Limited ('TSPL') being a core investment Company registered with RBI, is exempted under the Significant Beneficial Ownership (SBO) Rules. The Company does not have any other SBO as per SBO Rules to be reported in the Shareholding pattern as on June 30, 2026.   3. Since there is no category available as Foreign Institutional Investors and Foreign Bank under Other _ Inst (Foreign), the Company has chosen other and filed in the details under shareholders category.   4. Details of shares held mentioned under Other>Directors and their relatives is the details of shares held by the Independent Director and their relatives which is not mentioned above under Non Institution> Director and their relatives (other than independent directors and nominee directors).  5. PT TQCert Indonesia has been included as a part of the Promoter Group, consequent to its incorporation on May 26, 2026. TComm Turkey Dijital zmler Limited Sirketi, a wholly owned subsidiary (WOS) of Tata Communications International Pte. Ltd., which is, in turn, a WOS of Tata Communications Limited, has been added as a part of the Promoter Group with effect from May 21, 2026.  6.
